I am a Researcher at the Instituto de Telecomunicações and a Lecturer (Docente) at the University of Beira Interior, Portugal, working in the Pattern and Image Analysis group (Thematic Line on Information and Data Sciences). My research focuses on computer vision, biometric recognition, person re-identification, and machine learning systems that stay reliable in unconstrained visual conditions — including aerial-ground and extreme far-distance scenarios. Before moving to Portugal I worked in industry as a Senior Data Scientist, and I hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science from SRTM University, India.

Research

Person Re-Identification & Biometrics

Designing recognition systems that keep working at large scale, long range, and across camera domains.

  • Long-range and extreme far-distance person identification (DetReIDX, VReID-XFD)
  • Aerial-ground video-based ReID (AG-VPReID 2025 challenge results)
  • Cross-view, cross-domain and video-based ReID

VReID-XFD Workshop @ WACV 2026

Robust Vision Under Unconstrained Conditions

Understanding and mitigating the covariates that break recognition systems in real, unconstrained environments.

  • Domain generalization for gender recognition in unseen environments
  • Causality and 'in-the-wild' video-based ReID
  • Human Re-ID with large vision-language models (LVLMs)

Human Re-ID meets LVLMs

Applied ML, NLP & Data Science

Transferring research into practical systems — from smart manufacturing to healthcare document processing.

  • Automated fabric defect detection (industry prototype, PRR funded)
  • Information retrieval and NLP for clinical trial documents
  • Quantum graph neural networks, detection and biometric fusion

Quantum semi-supervised learning

Projects

Biometric Recognition at Extreme Ranges 2023 – 2025
Project Coordinator
Coordinated research on long-range human recognition in collaboration with 6 international universities, leading to the DetReIDX dataset and the VReID-XFD workshop at WACV 2026.
Automated Fabric Defect Detection Prototype 2023 – 2025
Researcher / Project Management · Portugal Recovery and Resilience Plan (PRR)
Contributed to project management and developed a computer-vision prototype for automated fabric defect detection with a Portuguese textile company.
NLP for Clinical Trial Document Analysis 2022 – 2023
Researcher · FEDER · Fundo de Coesão · Fundo Social Europeu (Portugal 2020)
Developed NLP models to process and extract relevant information from clinical trial documents.
Crime Hotspot Detection & Visualisation in Nanded City 2015 – 2017
Project Fellow · Government of Maharashtra (INR 108,000)
Identified crime hotspots using historical FIR data, Random Forest and GIS tools, producing heatmaps and recommendations for police resource allocation.
